_meta.identityConfidence: HIGH — 'operator-ciww' and 'operator-cardiff-international-white-water' are two separate content-inventory entries for the same real-world operator: Cardiff International White Water, Watkiss Way, Cardiff Bay CF11 0SY. The ciww slug originates from the hire.csv internal data source; the cardiff-international-white-water slug originates from kayak.csv and is aligned with the operator's official brand name and website domain (ciww.com). duplicateAnalysis.detail: The content inventory contains two separate entries for Cardiff International White Water: (1) operator-cardiff-international-white-water at /directory/cardiff-international-white-water (status: qa_needed, research complete) and (2) operator-ciww at /directory/ciww (status: research_needed, this task). Both entries carry the same blocker note: 'Operator "Cardiff International White Water" missing: no description, no cover image, no logo, no Google rating.' They refer to the same physical facility at Watkiss Way, Cardiff Bay, CF11 0SY and the same website (https://www.ciww.com).
duplicateAnalysis.origin: The slug divergence traces to different internal CSV sources: kayak.csv uses 'cardiff-international-white-water' (full brand name); hire.csv uses 'ciww' (the operator's short-form trading name and domain prefix). Both CSVs were ingested into the content inventory without deduplication, creating two live directory entries for one operator.
duplicateAnalysis.canonicalSlugReason: The operator's legal/brand name is 'Cardiff International White Water'. The short form 'CIWW' is used informally and as a website domain prefix, but the full name appears on the official website, Wikipedia, VisitWales, TripAdvisor, and all official communications. The slug 'cardiff-international-white-water' is consistent with the naming convention used for other long-form operator names in this directory.
duplicateAnalysis.proposedResolution: Canonicalise to /directory/cardiff-international-white-water. Add a 301 permanent redirect from /directory/ciww to /directory/cardiff-international-white-water. Remove or mark operator-ciww as inactive in content-inventory.csv and content-inventory.json. Update hire.csv slug from 'ciww' to 'cardiff-international-white-water' to prevent re-ingestion of the duplicate.
